categories.main_business_segments: The company primarily operates in synthetic rubber and latex production, focusing on SBR and NBR latex for glove manufacturing, oil-resistant rubber, refined rubber, and thermoplastic vulcanizates (TPV). It also engages in non-woven fabric, paper manufacturing, industrial rubber and plastic products, and international trade. The main revenue contributors are synthetic rubber latex products, especially for glove applications.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company utilizes advanced polymerization and compounding technologies for synthetic rubber latex (NBR, SBR) production. It employs dynamic vulcanization for thermoplastic vulcanizates and integrates process optimization to reduce production costs and improve product quality. R&D focuses on formula optimization, cost reduction, environmental compliance, and development of specialized rubber compounds for diverse applications.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include glove manufacturers, automotive parts producers, industrial equipment makers, electronics, medical device companies, and textile industries. The company serves global markets with a focus on Southeast Asia, China, and other emerging regions, supplying raw materials for disposable gloves, automotive components, and industrial rubber products.
categories.geographic_coverage: Operations are based in Taiwan (Linyuan plant) and China (Zhenjiang plant), with sales and investments extending to Southeast Asia, South Asia, Middle East, Eastern Europe, and global markets. The company also has offshore investment entities and subsidiaries to support international business and market expansion.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates primarily in the midstream segment of the synthetic rubber supply chain, producing raw latex and rubber compounds supplied to downstream manufacturers of gloves, automotive parts, and industrial products. It sources key petrochemical raw materials upstream and delivers value-added rubber products downstream.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include deepening expertise in NBR and oil-resistant rubber, developing high-value and environmentally friendly products aligned with ESG goals, and expanding market presence through regional market-oriented innovation. R&D focuses on cost reduction, new applications such as lithium battery electrode materials, halogen-free and carboxylated rubbers, and enhancing TPV competitiveness.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated mainly through product sales of synthetic rubber latex, oil-resistant rubber, refined rubber, and thermoplastic vulcanizates. The company also earns income from investments in subsidiaries and related companies. Pricing strategies are adjusted based on market conditions and raw material cost fluctuations.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company faces intense competition from Chinese and Southeast Asian synthetic rubber and glove latex producers, especially amid global oversupply and trade tensions. It positions itself as a quality-focused supplier with strong brand recognition in NBR latex and SBR products, leveraging strategic partnerships with glove manufacturers to maintain market share.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In the reported year, consolidated revenue reached approximately NT$11.36 billion, a 27.1% increase year-over-year, with net profit after tax of NT$879 million. The company maintains a strong financial structure with low debt-to-equity ratio (~8:92), high liquidity ratios, and steady profitability despite market challenges. Growth is driven by increased sales volume and strategic investments.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes high product quality, precise market positioning, and technical support to enhance customer production efficiency. It differentiates through continuous innovation in product formulations, cost-effective manufacturing, and development of sustainable, environmentally friendly rubber products. Strategic alliances with key customers and focus on ESG integration further strengthen its competitive edge.
